DocketPollRecord.description:
One harness poll of a forward cell's docket, as the cell's usage record carries it.

A poll reads the Court's docket JSON as served and runs the forward outcome scan
on it. ``open`` is narrower than it sounds: it means that JSON carried no
disposition the scan recognises at ``polled_at``, not that the event was
undecided — the JSON can lag the order or come from a cache, the scan's recall
is not perfect, and a disposition can land after the poll.

docket_number.description: The docket number polled, as the provisioned snapshot names it
docket_number.title: Docket Number

polled_at.description: When the poll's fetch began, in UTC
polled_at.title: Polled At

reason.description: Why the poll read decided or unavailable; null when open
reason.title: Reason

state.description: open: the docket JSON as served carried no disposition the forward outcome scan recognises; decided: it did; unavailable: the poll could not answer (no docket served, a body that is not JSON, a timeout, an error)
state.title: State

DocketPollRecord.title: DocketPollRecord

Engine.description: Agentic coding engine that produced an artifact.
Engine.title: Engine

UsageRole.description: Which agentic stage a usage record belongs to.
UsageRole.title: UsageRole

description:
``usage.json`` — measured model token usage and estimated cost for one run.

Written per ``run-predict`` / ``run-evaluate`` matrix cell (predictor x event
for predict, evaluator x event for evaluate) alongside that cell's prediction
or evaluation output. Token buckets follow the Claude convention:
``input_tokens`` is fresh input, with cached reads and cache writes counted
separately so ``estimated_cost_usd`` can apply the right rate to each (see
``fedcourtsai.pricing``). Summing these across runs replaces the planning
assumption with a measured \$/run.

engine_version.description: The engine CLI's version as its own binary reported it (`claude --version`, `codex --version`, `gemini --version`), read by the harness — never the agent's word. For the CLIs the harness installs (claude-code, gemini) the read is taken at install, before any agent ran; codex is installed by its action, so its read follows the run. An engine update under an unchanged process digest is composition, and this field is how a reading cuts by it. Null on records written before the field existed or when the binary's output named no version.
engine_version.title: Engine Version

engine_version_discrepancy.description: Set when the engine's version reads disagree: the binary reported a different version after the run than at install, or a version other than the pin the workflow installed from. The recorded `engine_version` is kept as read; this says the cell's engine is in doubt, and a reading cutting by engine version treats such a cell as unknown. Null when every read agrees, and on records written before the field existed.
engine_version_discrepancy.title: Engine Version Discrepancy

estimated_cost_usd.description: On-demand USD estimate from the rates in fedcourtsai.pricing
estimated_cost_usd.title: Estimated Cost Usd

model.description: Model the cost rates were applied to (resolved, never null)
model.title: Model

pipeline_sha.description: Git commit of the pipeline checkout that ran this cell (GITHUB_SHA in CI, the local HEAD otherwise) — pins the prompt templates, harness, and registry in force at run time. Null on records written before the field existed or when unresolvable.
pipeline_sha.title: Pipeline Sha

post_run_poll.description: The same poll taken after the cell's engine step ended. Record only: it never refuses or removes a cell. `pre_mint_poll` and `post_run_poll` both `open` say the whole run ended before the served docket showed a decision, not that the order was unpublished (an order list or a press account can precede the docket JSON); a `decided` post-run poll leaves the ordering inside the run unresolved. Either way leakage is read from the retrieval log's content. Null where no post-run poll ran.

pre_mint_poll.description: The harness's poll of a forward predict cell's docket just before its record was written. A cell whose poll reads `decided` is refused and writes no usage record, so a recorded poll is `open` or `unavailable`. `open` bounds the cell's exposure to a disposition to the window from `polled_at` to the end of the run; it is not proof the event was undecided (see DocketPollRecord). Null on evaluate cells, on cells minted before the poll existed, and wherever no poll ran.
